verbose.description: Enable verbose logging in cado; shows allowed/requested/unavailable capabilities.

authorizations.description: List of per-user or per-group capability authorizations. Each entry must specify either 'user' or 'group', and 'capabilities'. 'scado' and 'force' are optional booleans.

default_auth.description: Default capabilities granted to users/groups not matched by any explicit authorization. Must be a list of capability names (with or without 'cap_' prefix).
